capability: a persistent Hermes worker can search across bounded generations while Airlock keeps the operator objective, evaluator, selection rule, signed receipts, and promotion authority outside the worker
changes: Adds airlock nightshift as the Hermes-specific surface over governed continuous improvement.
Uses the official hermes -z scripted one-shot interface.
Defaults to one persistent Hermes worker attempt per generation.
Requires one distinct Hermes profile per candidate when parallel competition is requested.
Allows HERMES_HOME plus at most one explicitly named provider credential; repository/release credentials remain stripped.
Binds worker alias, external-process execution evidence, optional provider/model report, reported economics, checks, measurements, selection, and promoted commit into signed generation receipts.
Leaves the starting branch untouched while accepted generations compound on airlock/improve/<run-id>.
Documents the three-clock boundary: software Nightshift covers epistemic/transactional gates but does not claim sub-second physical feasibility control.
claim_boundary: The external-process receipt exercises the exact adapter contract but uses a fake Hermes executable. It does not establish live compatibility with an installed Nous Hermes runtime or provider. HERMES_HOME may contain credentials and native worktree execution is not a strong filesystem sandbox. A real Hermes run remains the final public compatibility proof.
invariants: Hermes may change candidate code and mutable Hermes profile state, but cannot own the committed objective or evaluator.
Hermes never receives Airlock release authority or GitHub tokens through the worker environment.
Parallel candidates cannot share a writable Hermes profile and still be treated as independent.
Only the operator-owned measurement and scoring rule may select one compounding improvement.
The starting branch is never moved by Nightshift.
A software admission receipt does not authorize deployment or substitute for a live dynamical inhibit layer.

validation.external_process_receipt: PASS: fake executable named hermes ran through configured hermes -z, required one model key, observed no GitHub credential or release authority, produced one patch, Airlock admitted/measured it, and the starting branch remained unchanged

wheel.local_build_note: built with --no-build-isolation because the model container has no package-network access; normal GitHub wheel job remains required
